first_step_test: One broad U-shaped band gives the learner both outside and inside curves with two flat upper ends. Its large connected shape is easy to place before small clips.

source.notes: One generated six-panel raster sheet. Source panels 1,2,4,5,6 form the approved five-step lesson; panel 3 duplicates panel 2 and remains private. Steps use direct additive marker, no guides; five square crops reviewed pairwise.

frames.visible_job: Draw a wide U with two upright sides and a rounded bottom. Turn across each flat top end and follow a smaller U inside, making one thick horseshoe-shaped band. Keep the opening wide enough for two floating paper clips.
frames.instruction: Draw a wide U with two upright sides and a rounded bottom. Turn across each flat top end and follow a smaller U inside, making one thick horseshoe-shaped band. Keep the opening wide enough for two floating paper clips.

frames.visible_job: Draw a horizontal seam across each arm below its flat end and a short vertical seam across the bottom center of the U. Above each tip, draw a narrow loop that curls back inside itself to form a paper clip. Tilt the left clip right and the right clip left, keeping a clear paper gap above each tip.
frames.instruction: Draw a horizontal seam across each arm below its flat end and a short vertical seam across the bottom center of the U. Above each tip, draw a narrow loop that curls back inside itself to form a paper clip. Tilt the left clip right and the right clip left, keeping a clear paper gap above each tip.

frames.visible_job: Inside each arm, draw a narrow rounded highlight shape below the tip seam. Add a thin U-shaped inset line along the inner curve of the magnet, stopping both ends below the tip seams so the metal caps remain clear.
frames.instruction: Inside each arm, draw a narrow rounded highlight shape below the tip seam. Add a thin U-shaped inset line along the inner curve of the magnet, stopping both ends below the tip seams so the metal caps remain clear.

frames.visible_job: In the open space between the clips, draw two small closed zigzag spark shapes, one above the left tip and one above the right. Keep both sparks separate from the clip wires and leave the center opening airy.
frames.instruction: In the open space between the clips, draw two small closed zigzag spark shapes, one above the left tip and one above the right. Keep both sparks separate from the clip wires and leave the center opening airy.

final_step.visible_job: Add red and cobalt marker fills, gray metal and yellow sparks within established outlines.
final_step.instruction: Fill the left half red and the right half cobalt blue, meeting at the bottom seam. Leave both enclosed highlights white. Shade the tips and clip wires lightly gray, fill the two sparks yellow, and darken the narrow inner bevel with the matching red or blue. Keep visible marker strokes inside the existing outlines.
adds: red cobalt gray and yellow marker fills

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop has one large connected U-shaped band. The two flat ends join inner and outer contours; there are no scattered guides or future clip details.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Read the revised five instructions against all four saved adjacent pairs. Omitting the duplicate source panel removes a no-change step. Two clips, three seams, two highlights, inner inset and two sparks all precede color and survive it.
